failures.test: indexes a deterministic 1,000,000+ line repository and measures all query latencies
failures.rootCause: buildContextPack issues 4 synchronous git process spawns per call (pack.ts rev-parse/branch/diff). On this machine git process spawn currently costs ~66-102ms (measured in isolation), so ctx carries ~300ms of spawn time plus ~300ms of in-process assembly over a 1M-line index. The in-situ probe measured 76.4ms so spawnAllowance could not lift the 500ms floor. The correctness assertions inside the test all pass; only the latency bound is exceeded.
failures.regressionCheck: git diff on packages/repo-intelligence, packages/context, and all dependencies of the measured path is empty — the mechanism is byte-identical to the R64 run where this test passed on the same machine (R64-suite-serial-heavy-3.json status passed). Four consecutive measurements cluster at 527-603ms on today's machine; earlier in the session the identical bound held.
failures.disposition: NOT a code regression; not relaxed; not hidden. The bound is a wall-clock benchmark assertion sensitive to process-spawn cost — the environment drifted. The recertification gate requires a fully green bounded run, so R65 certificate regeneration remains blocked until a run passes this test.
